Class ResourcePathConfig

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.config.ResourcePathConfig
public class ResourcePathConfig extends Object
Centralized resource path configuration for the application. This class provides methods to access various resources consistently.
Author:
Serhii Rybak
